summary: Phase 3 public marketing site tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest passed covering /api/public destinations, packages (list, scope filter, search, destination filter), package detail, draft hiding (404), agent_cost/commission_amount whitelist enforcement, contact submission (with & without package_slug), invalid payload validation, and Phase 2 admin login unchanged. Frontend: All required flows verified against the public preview URL — HomePage (hero tagline, listing cards, destination tiles), AboutPage, DestinationsPage grouping (International + Philippines), Destination detail (Japan shows Osaka package), missing destination shows dedicated 404 UI (data-testid=destination-not-found), PackagesPage with scope tabs (URL syncs ?scope=international, results reduce to 3 international / 1 Cebu domestic), search 'osaka' narrows to 1, destination=japan filter narrows to 1, PackageDetailPage renders title, ₱ price, inclusions, exclusions, and 'Contact an agent' CTA linking to /contact?package=osaka-kyoto-nara-5d4n, draft slug japan-sakura-preview and unknown slug show not-found UI, no agent_cost/commission_amount text leaks. Contact form submits and shows 'Message sent'. Header nav-login-link goes to /login; after admin login (yongmichael992@gmail.com/Admin@12345), nav-portal-link appears pointing to /admin. Mobile (390x780): nav-mobile-toggle opens nav-mobile-panel, no horizontal overflow on home/packages/pkg-detail. Tablet (820x1180): package grid is 2-column (first two cards on same row).
critical_code_review_comments: public.py contact endpoint stores IP + user-agent — acceptable but consider basic rate-limiting to prevent contact-form spam.
public.py uses regex search on title/summary without a Mongo text index; fine at current seed size but flag if catalog grows.
money_from_bson result is str-cast for guest_price; ensure frontend formats consistently (currently OK, renders ₱).
